docs: astro-1
The Veyra Observatory sits at 2,400 metres on Mount Halden and houses a 1.8 metre reflecting telescope. It began operating on 12 June 1987 and mostly tracks faint asteroids.
astro-2
Comet Tarsis-Ono returns to the inner solar system every 76 years. Its last perihelion passage was in February 1986, and the next is predicted for July 2062.
astro-3
A lunar eclipse happens when the Earth moves between the Sun and the Moon, so our planet's shadow darkens the lunar surface. Totality can last up to about 100 minutes.
astro-4
Saturn's rings are made mostly of water ice particles, from dust grains to boulders the size of houses. They are remarkably thin, often only ten metres thick.
astro-5
Dr. Marit Lindqvist discovered the exoplanet Kepla-9b in 2019 using the transit method, watching its star dim by 0.4 percent each time the planet crossed its face.
astro-6
Amateur stargazers should use a red torch at night, because red light keeps the eyes adapted to darkness. Full dark adaptation takes roughly twenty minutes.
astro-7
The Orlov Space Telescope launched in March 2021 and orbits a million and a half kilometres from Earth. Its gold-coated mirror has a diameter of 6.5 metres.
astro-8
Neutron stars are the collapsed cores of massive stars; a teaspoon of their material would weigh about a billion tonnes.
cook-1
Sourdough bread needs a starter of flour and water that has fermented for about a week. Bake at 230 degrees Celsius for 40 minutes in a covered pot for a crisp crust.
cook-2
Chef Anselm Brandt's famous goulash uses two kilograms of beef shoulder, paprika, and a long three-hour simmer. He opened his restaurant Brandt's Table in Vienna in 1999.
cook-3
To keep guacamole from browning, press cling film directly onto its surface; acid from lime juice also slows the oxidation of the avocado flesh.
cook-4
Risotto rice such as arborio releases starch when stirred slowly with warm stock added a ladle at a time. The dish is done after roughly eighteen minutes.
cook-5
A cast iron skillet should be dried right after washing and rubbed with a thin coat of oil, otherwise rust spots appear on the pan.
cook-6
The Marlow Street Bakery sells 300 croissants every morning, each made with 27 layers of laminated butter dough, and closes at 2 pm on Sundays.
cook-7
Boiling pasta in heavily salted water, about ten grams of salt per litre, seasons the noodles from within. Reserve a cup of the cooking liquid for the sauce.
cook-8
Fermenting cabbage with two percent salt by weight produces sauerkraut in about two weeks at room temperature, as lactic acid bacteria sour it.
fin-1
An emergency fund should cover three to six months of living expenses and be kept in an easily accessible savings account.
fin-2
The Halvorsen Credit Union raised its savings rate to 4.35 percent on 1 September 2025, applying to balances up to 50,000 euros.
fin-3
Compound interest means you earn returns on previous returns: 1,000 euros at 5 percent a year grows to about 1,629 euros after ten years.
fin-4
Index funds track a market benchmark and charge low annual fees, often below 0.2 percent, which is why many long-term savers prefer them over active managers.
fin-5
Late payments on a credit card typically trigger a penalty fee and can lower your credit score for several years.
fin-6
Ruth Okafor, treasurer of the Eastgate Allotment Society, reported a budget surplus of 2,310 euros for the 2024 fiscal year.
fin-7
The mortgage deadline for the Brisley First-Home Grant is 30 April 2026; applicants must have a deposit of at least 10 percent.
fin-8
Budgeting by the 50/30/20 rule sends half of take-home pay to needs, thirty percent to wants and twenty percent to saving or debt repayment.
cyc-1
Correct tyre pressure for a road bike is usually between 80 and 110 psi; wider tyres on rough roads run lower for comfort and grip.
cyc-2
The Alderwick Gran Fondo takes place on 21 September and covers 142 kilometres with 2,100 metres of climbing, starting from the village green.
cyc-3
A chain should be cleaned and lubricated every 200 kilometres or after riding in the rain, otherwise it wears out the cassette quickly.
cyc-4
Cadence is the rate at which a cyclist turns the pedals. Most riders are efficient between 80 and 100 revolutions per minute.
cyc-5
Coach Tomasz Wrede designed a six-week hill training plan: two interval sessions weekly plus one long ride of at least three hours.
cyc-6
Disc brakes stop more reliably than rim brakes in wet weather, but need regular bleeding of hydraulic fluid and pad replacement.
cyc-7
Cyclists should signal turns early with a clearly extended arm and ride at least one metre from parked cars to avoid opening doors.
cyc-8
The Corran Valley cycle path opened in May 2022; it is 38 kilometres long, fully paved, and follows a disused railway line.
gar-1
Tomato seedlings should be planted outside only after the last frost, when night temperatures stay above ten degrees Celsius.
gar-2
Gardener Pilar Quintana's rose collection at Hollin House includes 214 varieties, and the garden opens to visitors from 1 May to 30 September.
gar-3
Compost needs a balance of green material such as grass clippings and brown material such as dry leaves, turned every few weeks to stay aerated.
gar-4
Slugs can be deterred without chemicals by laying crushed eggshells or copper tape around vulnerable seedlings.
gar-5
Lavender prefers poor, well-drained soil and full sun; overwatering causes root rot and shortens the life of the shrub.
gar-6
Garlic cloves are pushed into the soil in October, pointed end up, and harvested the following July once the leaves yellow.
gar-7
The Fennimore Seed Library lends out about 900 packets a year, and members return seeds from their own plants after harvest.
gar-8
Pruning apple trees in late winter, while they are dormant, encourages strong spring growth and better fruit yield.
db-1
A database index speeds up lookups by keeping a sorted structure of column values, at the price of slower writes and more disk space.
db-2
SQLite stores an entire database in a single file and runs inside the application process, so no separate server needs to be installed.
db-3
Version 4.2 of the Quillon library, released on 8 January 2025, deprecated the synchronous client and added native async support.
db-4
A transaction groups several statements so they either all succeed or all roll back, which keeps data consistent after a crash.
db-5
Developer Idris Calloway wrote the Pellucid parser in 2023; it handles 40 megabytes of JSON per second on a single core.
db-6
Normalising a schema removes duplicated data by splitting it into related tables joined with foreign keys.
db-7
Unit tests check small pieces of code in isolation, and run in milliseconds, so they can be executed on every commit.
db-8
Caching stores the results of expensive computations in memory; the hardest part is deciding when a cached value becomes stale.
hist-1
The town of Marlbury received its market charter in 1247, allowing traders to hold a weekly fair every Thursday.
hist-2
Marlbury Bridge, built of local sandstone in 1389, has five arches and was widened in 1851 to carry carts.
hist-3
A great fire in 1666 destroyed most timber houses in the old quarter, and the council afterwards required new buildings to use brick or stone.
hist-4
Mayor Eleanor Whitcombe founded the Marlbury Free Library in 1903 with a donation of 4,000 books from her private collection.
hist-5
The Marlbury woollen mill employed about 600 workers at its peak in 1880 before closing in 1957.
hist-6
Archaeologists excavating the castle moat in 2014 uncovered a trove of 112 silver pennies from the reign of an early king.
hist-7
The railway reached Marlbury on 4 August 1862, cutting the journey to the capital from a full day by coach to three hours.
hist-8
Each autumn the town celebrates the Apple Fair, a tradition in which growers parade the heaviest fruit through the high street.
net-1
Wi-Fi signal weakens through thick walls, so placing the router centrally and high on a shelf gives better coverage.
net-2
The Vantage X300 router supports speeds of up to 2.4 gigabits per second and costs 189 euros, with firmware update 3.1 released in March 2025.
net-3
A VPN encrypts traffic between your device and a remote server, hiding your browsing from other people on a public network.
net-4
Changing the default administrator password on a router is the first step, because factory credentials are published online.
net-5
Network engineer Sunniva Berg recommends splitting guest devices onto a separate VLAN so visitors cannot reach the file server.
net-6
Ethernet cables of category 6 carry gigabit traffic up to 100 metres, and are less prone to interference than wireless links.
net-7
A DNS server translates a website's name into a numeric address; switching to a faster resolver can shave tens of milliseconds off page loads.
net-8
Backups should follow the 3-2-1 rule: three copies of data, on two different media, with one copy kept offsite.
